podcast.title: Contemporary Catalog Sale
podcast.body: The Chainsmokers are mentioned as contemporary artists who have sold some or all of their song catalog, joining a growing movement of musicians converting their publishing rights into large upfront payments.

podcast.title: New EDM Generation
podcast.body: The Chainsmokers are listed as part of the new generation of EDM artists who, along with Avicii, Calvin Harris, and Swedish House Mafia, faced immediate and intense pressure from the music promotion industry. "cuando llegue a esta nueva generación y ya no es sules a bici, es Carlmejarris, son los hubis jasmaphia, es actual, son los chainsmokers, toda esta gente, esa gente ya no lo tiene tan fácil."
